evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/s/h/a carries plugin name 'Timers / Info Boxes', config group 'infoBoxes', enabled-by-default state and potion/boost/buff/skill tags.

The plugin manages timer/counter/status infoboxes for antifire/antipoison/antivenom, freeze/teleblock, task progress, wandering merchant, soul hunter, raid afflictions and combat-skill boosts; it reacts to ConfigChanged and SkillLevelChanged.
SpawnPK public update history explicitly calls the feature 'Timers / Info Boxes' and describes the same movable/customizable timer, counter and task-progress infobox system.
